Jhang to Chiniot Pakistan Road Trip | Old Railway Station, Punjabi Mela & Local Life
In this vlog, we travel from Jhang to Chiniot, exploring the real beauty of rural Punjab in Pakistan. Along the way, we visit Kheewa, drive through scenic villages, explore the historic Jhang Sadar Railway Station, witness a traditional Punjabi fair, and discuss the stories of Mirza Sahiba, Tata, India-Pakistan, and local life.
